output.subject: We've received your report about the CRYPTOQUIK.IO charge
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that a charge of $49.99 from CRYPTOQUIK.IO, dated 9/6, appeared on your debit card and that you did not make it. You told us your card has been in your wallet the entire time and that you have never heard of this company. You have asked us to reverse the charge and to send you a new card.

We understand how unsettling it is to find a charge you don't recognize, and we're sorry for the worry this has caused. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

In the meantime, if you notice any other charges you don't recognize, please let us know so they can be included in the review.

Thank you for your patience.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer reports an unauthorized $49.99 debit card charge from CRYPTOQUIK.IO on 9/6, with the card still in their possession.
Customer asked for the charge to be reversed. Decide whether to provisionally credit or dispute it before replying.
Customer asked for a replacement card. Check whether the card has been blocked or reissued, since it may be compromised and open to further fraudulent use.
Check the account for any other charges from this merchant or other unrecognized activity since 9/6.
Customer included their card number in the web form. Consider advising them not to send card details through this channel.
The draft does not tell the customer how to lock or cancel the card. Add those steps if appropriate, given the possible ongoing exposure.
